verdicts.reason: Both use the same enlarged three-line headline over the busy interior photo. It reads well, but it has no backing panel, the dark lamp fragment on the left edge crowds the 'C', and the right third of the canvas is dead space. A joins the blue and black info boxes into one band aligned to the headline's left edge, which keeps them grouped like the original's stacked panels, though the band stops short at about two-thirds of the width. B splits the boxes with an arbitrary gap, and the black box lines up with neither the headline's right edge nor the canvas, so the two boxes look scattered rather than grouped.
